items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements the operator finding's 4 required points exactly: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS set alongside existing env vars, resolved dynamically from Codextender's /v1/models (no hardcoded number), safe undefined fallback on probe failure, cleaned up on all 3 shells. No extra features added (YAGNI); confirmed by the spec-reviewer PASS.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: resolveCodextenderMaxContextTokens never throws -- delegates to probeCodextenderModels's never-throw contract (network error, timeout, non-2xx, malformed body all resolve to undefined/ok:false). No new API routes added; the two call sites (chokepoint, fork) both already handle a false/undefined probe result gracefully.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No raw user input reaches SQL or HTML. No hardcoded secrets -- the auth-token temp-file mechanism is untouched by this diff. max_input_tokens from the proxy response is validated (type/integer/positive) before ever being interpolated into a shell command string via String().

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert on outcomes (presence/absence of the env var and its value in the generated command strings across all 3 shells), not internal state. Happy-path (valid max_input_tokens) and error-path (probe failure, unknown alias, missing field, malformed values) tests exist at every layer: probe parsing, resolver function, launcher env-var injection, and both chokepoint/fork plumbing call sites.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: No N+1 pattern, no unbounded list, no synchronous blocking. The new network probe is timeout-bounded (1500ms, AbortController) and mirrors the existing liveness-probe pattern; assessed as an acceptable trade for a low-frequency, user-initiated launch action by the code-reviewer.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: File/folder locations match project conventions. Three files that crossed the 300-line guideline (runtime-chokepoint.ts, launcher-codextender.test.ts, runtime-chokepoint.codextender.test.ts) were split cohesively by concern (mirroring the existing fork.ts-split-from-lifecycle.ts precedent), not merged/compressed -- all touched files now sit under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: Codextender's LiteLLM proxy /v1/models HTTP JSON response. Consumer: resolveCodextenderMaxContextTokens -> buildCodextenderCommands. This is an external-service HTTP boundary, not a user-edited on-disk format, so the 8 boundary-probe categories (aimed at user-edited formats) don't directly apply; instead the malformed-input space (0, negative, fractional, string-typed, absent max_input_tokens) is covered by dedicated parser tests in codextender-proxy-probe.test.ts. touches_io_boundary risk flag did not fire (no .env/hooks.json/settings.json/*_config.json touched, no parse_env/json.load/yaml keyword match in the diff).
